# Chhaya Global School & Pearl Kidz, Akola

> Preschool and school in Ramdaspeth, Akola, Maharashtra, India, since 2012. Pearl Kidz runs Playgroup (age 2+). Chhaya Global School (CGS) runs Nursery (EY1), Jr KG (EY2), Sr KG (EY3) and Std 1 to Std 10. Admissions for 2027-28 are open from Playgroup to Std 10. No donation and no deposit.

## Key facts
- Address: Opposite Tilak Park, Near Smile Hospital, Birla Road, Ramdaspeth, Akola, Maharashtra 444001
- Admissions and WhatsApp: +91 83694 13115. Principal: +91 88886 16064. Email: principal@chhayaglobalschool.com
- Office hours: Monday to Sunday, 8:00 AM to 7:30 PM (call before a Sunday visit)
- Founded: 2012 (as Pearl Kidz). Founder: Dr. Chhaya Mishra, Ph.D. in Economics, NET, M.Phil (Gold Medalist), 20+ years of college teaching
- Early years follow the Foundational Stage of India's National Education Policy (NEP 2020): play and activity-based learning
- Small classes; teachers know every child by name; one campus from Playgroup to Std 10, so no school change at age 6
- Fees: no donation, no deposit; full fee sheet shared before admission
- Free campus visits: book on WhatsApp +91 83694 13115
